messages: I met this girl named #p403# in #m10003000#. She's devastated about losing the lucky coin that she borrowed from a friend, and she asked me to find it for her. She told me a bunch of guys draped in white cloths picked it up when she dropped it, and that I might find them at #bConstruction Site B1#k, deep in the subway station... I guess I should head there first...

I found the lost coin that #p403# of #m10003000# was looking for and returned it to her. A precious coin borrowed from her friend, huh...? As a reward, she gave me a bunch of return scrolls... Not bad at all!! She also said other items can be found at #bConstruction Site B1#k... I should check it out later...
name: [Construction Site B1] Shumi's Lost Coin
